cards.title: 多智能体之争 封面底图
cards.prompt:
A cinematic ultra-wide 21:9 horizontal composition, deep navy-black to near-black background, cold and restrained. The upper half is mostly empty, clean and dimmed with large negative space. In the lower-middle area: a single bright amber-gold core node (an orchestrator) hovering at center, from which many small glowing satellite nodes fan out along thin light trails into TWO opposing arcs — the left arc is cool blue, nodes flying in neat parallel formation toward tidy stacks of translucent document planes; the right arc is warm orange-red, nodes tangling and colliding mid-air, their light trails crossing and knotting into a small chaotic snarl. One side shows disciplined parallel work, the other shows beautiful chaos. Subtle blueprint grid texture fading into the dark background. Clean, engineered, minimal, not cluttered.

STRICTLY EXCLUDE: any text, letters, digits, numbers, symbols, handwriting, sci-fi HUD panels, robot figures, human faces or people, logos, watermarks, dense particle noise.

Hard requirements: no text anywhere in the image (the golden glowing title will be overlaid later by a script). Main visual concentrated in the lower-middle band; the upper area must stay empty and dim. Keep important elements away from all four edges for safe cropping.
